entradas.text: Livia intercepted me in front of my office and informed me that I had a call from Walter Tusk.
I entered and picked up the phone.

entradas.menu: “President Rayne speaking.”

entradas.text: “Mr. Tusk. To what do I owe the pleasure?”
entradas.menu: “Mr. Tusk. To what do I owe the pleasure?”
“Walter. What do you want?”

entradas.text: “If you don't do it, you will suffer the consequences.”
“If you want to keep being one.”
“Here is what this will cost you.”
“Not the nicest way to pick up the phone.”
“Have a good afternoon and think about what I said.”
“All I ask is for you to think about it.”
“That's not too much to ask, is it?"
“News about a deal between you and Marcel Koronti.”

entradas.menu: “Why am I not surprised?”

entradas.text: “I want you to start an investigation into Heart of Sordland. That's all I ask.”

entradas.menu: “There is no such thing.”
“Where did you hear that?”
“What kind of a deal?”

entradas.text: “Very well. I will see what I can do.”
entradas.menu: “Very well. I will see what I can do.”
“No promises.”

entradas.text: “I will give all the information I have to the officials.”
“When one is in business as long as I am, one hears things.”
“I found some evidence linking him to Koranelli cartel. A powerful crime syndicate.”
“I wouldn't tell you if that wasn't the case.”
“I did not call you to threaten you.”
“I am calling you as a friend.”
“You will bring a known criminal to justice.”
“I want him out of the equation.”
“I do. But why are you helping me?”
entradas.menu: “I do. But why are you helping me?”

entradas.text: “Thank you, Walter. I'm glad I can depend on you."
entradas.menu: “Thank you, Walter. I'm glad I can depend on you."

entradas.text: “If you ever use this against me...”
entradas.menu: “If you ever use this against me...”

entradas.text: “Is the information about the cartel ties verified?”
entradas.menu: “Is the information about the cartel ties verified?”
“No promises.”
“Very well. Deal.”

entradas.text: “I wouldn't make threats if I were you.”
“Are you certain? That is a big accusation.”
entradas.menu: “Are you certain? That is a big accusation.”

entradas.text: “I have to attend to my business now.”
“That's not too much to ask, right?"
“Now, nothing in this life is free.”
“Let me tell you what I want first and I will let you decide.”
“I want you to start an investigation into Heart of Sordland. That's all I ask.”
“I don't believe it. You are just trying to undermine him.”
entradas.menu: “I don't believe it. You are just trying to undermine him.”

entradas.text: “I will decide after I see the evidence.”
entradas.menu: “I will decide after I see the evidence.”

entradas.text: “I will feed the information to the officials.”

entradas.menu: “What do you want?”

entradas.text: “I won't give in to your false accusations.”
entradas.menu: “I won't give in to your false accusations.”
“You dare threaten me?”

entradas.text: “What I want from you is simple.”
“I found some evidence linking him to the Koranelli cartel. A powerful crime syndicate.”
“I wouldn't call you if I wasn't.”
“This is your lucky day. I've already ordered an investigation into HOS.”
entradas.menu: “This is your lucky day. I've already ordered an investigation into HOS.”
